source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.

1F exterior window heights (sill 1.0m/head 2.6m) and the west main-entry door height (0-2.2m) are confirmed against North/West elevation dimension chains (claims 0001, 0004). Interior corridor-to-room doors on both floors remain an explicit 2.1m assumption; no elevation shows internal doors.
Interior door widths estimated from arc/jamb pixel positions; exact jamb-to-jamb widths approximate (~600-1300mm range) since some door frame marks overlap partition end symbols.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
No exterior door observed on this floor's plan; vertical circulation (stairs) not depicted in the supplied drawings and is not invented here.

Interior corridor-to-room doors remain an explicit 2.1m assumption; no elevation shows internal doors.

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound view_image returns are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

room_use_review.next_action: Use-basis records saved; unresolved inferences remain explicit.
room_use_review.interpretation: Counts cover structured role_evidence only, not semantic correctness. Legacy source_refs may contain other evidence. Unknown remains a fallback when no defensible listed use fits; it is not a preferred response to ambiguity.

decision.reason: North elevation dimension chain matches the already-applied 1F window sill/head values (1.0-2.6m).

claims.reason: North_view.png right-side vertical dimension chain for the lower (1F) window column reads 400/1600/1000 mm from the floor-division line (absolute z=3.0m, top of 1F) downward to the ground (z=0). Segment index 1 (the 1600mm window height) gives head=3.0-0.4=2.6m and sill=3.0-2.0=1.0m, matching all 1F exterior windows which share one height family per the elevation.

decision.reason: North elevation dimension chain matches the already-applied 2F window sill/head values (4.0-5.8m absolute).

claims.reason: North_view.png right-side vertical dimension chain for the upper (2F) window column reads 800/1800/1000 mm from the roofline (absolute z=6.6m, total building height) downward to the 1F/2F floor division (z=3.0). Segment index 1 (the 1800mm window height) gives head=6.6-0.8=5.8m and sill=6.6-2.6=4.0m, matching all 2F exterior windows which share one height family per the elevation.

decision.reason: Image-axis pixel reading placed the door bottom ~34mm below the ground anchor (measurement noise on a coarse full-image pixel read); replacing with a literal claim rounded to the already-applied 0-2.2m value, still grounded in the same West elevation measurement.

claims.reason: West_view.png double-door glyph measured against the overall 6600mm elevation dimension: wall top at pixel y=180 (z=6.6m) and ground at pixel y=566 (z=0m) give scale 386px/6.6m=58.5px/m. The door top edge at pixel y=438 and bottom at pixel y=568 (approx ground) give door height=(568-438)/58.5=2.22m, so head z=2.2m from ground.
unresolved: Anchor pixel y=180/566 for wall top/ground read from a wider full-image view, not exactly this crop; small pixel-reading uncertainty (~2-3px, tens of mm) remains.

decision.reason: West elevation door glyph measurement matches the already-applied main entry door height (0-2.2m).

claims.reason: West_view.png double-door glyph height measured against the overall 6600mm elevation dimension (wall top pixel y=180=z6.6m, ground pixel y=566=z0m, scale 58.5px/m): door spans essentially the full pixel range from ground to about 2.2m (measured top edge pixel y=438, giving (566-438)/58.5=2.19m, rounded to 2.2m for the door head), so z=[0,2.2].

decision.reason: South elevation visual estimate is consistent with the already-applied 2.1m room4 entry door height.

claims.reason: South_view.png shows this door reaching from near the ground up to roughly 2.0-2.3m using the 6600mm overall elevation scale (~61 px/m); pixel precision on this door glyph is coarser than the main entry, so the value is kept at the already-applied standard 2.1m door height rather than an over-precise pixel figure.
unresolved: Exact pixel-measured door height is approximate (~2.0-2.3m range); 2.1m standard value retained rather than an imprecise pixel figure.
